annotations.title: Private jet vs first class calculator: cost per person

description: All prices and times are the caller’s own: the tool holds no fares or charter rates, and the defaults are an illustrative example, not quotes. The jet cost (quote + fees + extras) is shared equally; first class is fare + taxes per person, plus group extras. Break-even = ceil((jet total − first-class extras) ÷ (fare + taxes)). Times are per one-way journey and doubled for a return. Optional hourlyValue values each traveller’s hour saved. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/private-jet-vs-first-class-calculator

firstAfterMinutes.description: First class: time after landing (immigration, baggage). Minutes, one way.

firstBeforeMinutes.description: First class: time at the airport before departure. Minutes, one way.

firstExtras.description: First-class extras for the group: transfers, lounge, excess baggage, pets.

firstFare.description: First-class fare per person for the whole trip.

firstFlightMinutes.description: First class: flight time including any connection. Minutes, one way.

firstTaxes.description: First-class taxes and charges per person, if not in the fare.

hourlyValue.description: Optional value of each traveller’s time per hour; 0 leaves time out of the cost comparison.

jetAfterMinutes.description: Jet: time after landing. Minutes, one way.

jetBeforeMinutes.description: Jet: time at the airport before departure. Minutes, one way.

jetExtras.description: Jet extras for the group: transfers, VIP terminal, catering, pets.

jetFees.description: Jet fees not in the quote: taxes, positioning, landing, de-icing.

jetFlightMinutes.description: Jet: flight time. Minutes, one way.

jetQuote.description: Private jet charter quote for the whole aircraft and the whole trip.

jetSeats.description: Passenger seats on the aircraft quoted.

tripType.description: oneway or return. Return doubles the door-to-door times; prices are for the whole trip either way.
